youtube.title: Why does your zipper *always* fall? 👖 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Jeans zippers feature a locking mechanism inside the pull tab. When the tab is pushed down flat against the zipper teeth, a small prong engages to prevent the slider from moving.
